space.coords: game px, y down, relative to the figure position; x mirrors when facing left
space.anchors: image px of the character's keyframe PNGs (per action, per frame); game px = (p - image_origin_px) * game_px_per_image_px * position_scale

note: Thear FX, theme 'Weight': earth (dust, rock chips, flattened shockwaves), steel (heavy dull smears) and killing intent (tarnished molten gold that stays buried until he gets serious). Quiet on the one-handed chain, louder on the special, the world breaks on Earthfall.
